shortDescription: Module for setup of GslbSMRuntime Avi RESTful Object

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_deactivate_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Deactivate Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: avi_patch_path
options.description: Patch path to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_patch_value
options.description: Patch value to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: cluster_leader
options.description: The controller cluster leader node uuid. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: cluster_uuid
options.description: The site controller cluster uuid. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: controller_flavor
options.description: Controller flavor of the peer site controller. Enum options - CONTROLLER_ESSENTIALS, CONTROLLER_SMALL, CONTROLLER_MEDIUM, CONTROLLER_LARGE, CONTROLLER_EXTRA_LARGE. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: dns_configs
options.description: Sub domain configuration for the gslb. Gslb services fqdn must be a match one of these subdomains. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: dns_info
options.description: Dns info at the site. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Activate/de-activate state retrieved from the cfg. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: events
options.description: Captures sm related events. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: health_monitor_info
options.description: This field will provide information on origin(site name) of the health monitoring information. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: leader_cluster_uuid
options.description: Mark this site as leader of gslb configuration. This site is the one among the avi sites. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: member_type
options.description: The sites member type  a leader is set to active while all members are set to passive. Enum options - GSLB_ACTIVE_MEMBER, GSLB_PASSIVE_MEMBER. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as GSLB_PASSIVE_MEMBER.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of db entry. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: node_uuid
options.description: The controller cluster node uuid that processes the site.sites are sharded across the cluster nodes. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: num_of_retries
options.description: Number of retry attempts to reach the remote site. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.

options.name: obj_state
options.description: Represents the state of the site. Enum options - SITE_STATE_NULL, SITE_STATE_JOIN_IN_PROGRESS, SITE_STATE_LEAVE_IN_PROGRESS, SITE_STATE_INIT, SITE_STATE_UNREACHABLE, SITE_STATE_MMODE, SITE_STATE_DISABLE_IN_PROGRESS, SITE_STATE_DISABLED, SITE_STATE_HS_IN_PROGRESS. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as SITE_STATE_NULL.

options.name: obj_uuid
options.description: Gslb sm runtime object uuid. Points to the gslb to which this belongs. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: oper_status
options.description: Gslb site operational status, represents whether site is up or down. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: remote_info
options.description: Remote info is basically updated by grw. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: role
options.description: Site role  leader or follower. Enum options - GSLB_LEADER, GSLB_MEMBER, GSLB_NOT_A_MEMBER. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as GSLB_NOT_A_MEMBER.

options.name: site_name
options.description: The gslb site name. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: site_type
options.description: Indicates if it is avi site or third-party. Enum options - GSLB_AVI_SITE, GSLB_THIRD_PARTY_SITE. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: sw_version
options.description: Current software version of the site. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as Not-Initialized.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: Uuid of the tenant. It is a reference to an object of type tenant. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: The uuid of db entry. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: view_id
options.description: The view-id is used in change-leader mode to differentiate partitioned groups while they have the same gslb namespace. Each partitioned group will be able to operate independently by using the view-id. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.
